title: VeloraOS 1.10.57 - Knowledge Library & PWA File Experience
notes: Rebuilds Knowledge as a private per-user document library with metadata, local extraction, open, rename, re-index, retry and permanent removal controls.
Adds native PWA document, photo and camera imports with previews, progress, cancellation, retry and drag-and-drop support.
Adds secure PWA Share Target and File Handling integration using a private local inbox before authenticated import.
Supports local PDF, DOCX, text, Markdown, CSV, JSON and privacy-conscious image indexing while preserving official VeloraOS model routing.
